title: Custom styles docx 001
notes: real custom paragraph styles defined in word/styles.xml via doc.styles.add_style(builtin=False): GP Body basedOn Normal (w:basedOn w:val="Normal", size override) and GP Head basedOn Heading 1 (w:basedOn w:val="Heading1", own w:color 6B3FA0); both styles are applied to body paragraphs via w:pPr/w:pStyle. styles.xml content asserted after save.
